name: @typstream/engine
description: Compiles streamed Typst in a worker: heals on the main thread, schedules compiles, and recovers from runaway documents.

scripts.check:api: api-extractor run && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.server.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.websocket.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.images.json
scripts.api:update: api-extractor run --local && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.server.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.websocket.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.images.json
